name: Canva Craft
summary: Generate product graphics, posters, and social images at up to 2K resolution, with prompts that specify layout, object placement, and text. Use it in Canva’s Dream Lab or add image generation to your app through the public API.

name: Decisions API
summary: Route support requests, classify images, or choose an agent’s next step without generating a full chat response. The API is now generally available at $0.10 per million input tokens, with no output charges and up to 400 questions per request.

name: Resend Inboxes
summary: Give your AI agents an email address to receive tasks, track conversations, and draft replies. Connect through an API, CLI, or MCP, with up to three free inboxes and controls over what agents can do.

name: Flint
summary: Fix bugs and build features with a coding model that runs on your own computer. Download the Apache 2.0 weights for Ollama or LM Studio, or use the optimized Mac runner on supported chips with at least 48 GB of memory.

name: UseIt Studio
summary: Design stickers, packaging, cards, and brand kits by describing what you want, then refine individual elements through conversation. The browser app exports editable files with real dimensions, bleed, and cut lines so you can move from mockup to printing.

name: Granite Speech 5.0
summary: Transcribe recordings in six languages and translate speech into or from English. Download the Apache 2.0 model and run it with Transformers, llama.cpp, or Apple Silicon tools to build private transcription features without per-minute API fees.

name: Voxtral 3
summary: Build voice agents that can listen, call your tools, and speak back in real time through one SDK. The API starts at $0.04 per minute for complete agents, with standalone batch transcription from $0.0035 per minute across 50+ languages.

name: FLUX 3 Max
summary: Turn a text prompt or starting image into a 5–20 second 720p video with native audio, with a 10-second clip rendering in about 12 seconds. Use it on fal for $2.55 per minute through November 7, then $10.20.
